messages:
Sasha (Partnerships): Heads up 04: Nebula Systems PO blocked by portal: MP-509 alias_region_mismatch. They need EU merchant alias + net-45. Announcement next week, need fast path.

Viktor (Sales): They signed SOW/MSA but asked invoices from 'Nebula EU Ltd'. Portal only has 'Nebula Systems, Inc'.

Mei (Legal): Can't proceed without mapping or contract amendment allowing EU invoice entity. I can draft a one-paragraph amendment limited to marketplace POs.

Priya (Finance): We can create a provisional EU vendor record if VAT reg cert + remit contact provided. Net-45 needs treasury signoff for >$50k; PO is $42.5k so finance can approve conditionally with 10% retention.

MarketplaceOps: We can create provisional alias prov-neb-eu but must tag pending_vat. That will allow portal to accept PO but block invoice settlement until docs verified.

Sasha (Partnerships): Plan: Viktor get VAT + remit contact (ETA 24h), Ops create prov alias, Mei drafts amendment, Finance holds 10% until verification. Agree?

Viktor (Sales): Pinged Nebula rep for VAT cert and signed ack.

BillingBot: After alias creation in staging, simulated PO accepted: PO-NEB-2026-248 status pending_invoicing.

Priya (Finance): Once VAT received and verified, Finance will toggle alias active and release invoice pickup. Approving provisional net-45 subject to signed acknowledgement.

Mei (Legal): Amendment uploaded: https://redwood-internal/docs/amendments/nebu-eu-provisional.pdf. Scope limited, non-precedent language included.

MarketplaceOps: VAT verified, changing alias to active_eu_nebula. Invoice processing enabled.

BillingBot: PO-NEB-2026-248 now ready_for_invoice.

Sasha (Partnerships): Announcement greenlit. Will file a follow-up to improve alias onboarding UX. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
